captions: Mine started in a small village in India, with a big ambition
to build a future through learning.
I completed my Electrical and Electronics Engineering degree.
It taught me to think in systems,
trace a problem to its source, and look for evidence,
My first turn into software was software testing.
What began as a way to understand whether technology worked
finding what could fail before it mattered to someone.
Over eighteen years, that craft grew into
global team mentoring and AI quality engineering,
helping teams ship with stronger evidence and confidence.
